name: Bill
description: A bill — an Accounts Payable transaction recording amounts owed to a vendor.

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object, assigned by QuickBooks Online. Filterable and sortable. Required for update/delete.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object, used for optimistic concurrency control. Required (along with Id) for update operations.

fields.name: VendorRef
fields.description: Reference to the vendor for this bill. The vendor must already exist in QuickBooks. Required to create a bill.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Vendor object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Vendor.

fields.name: Line
fields.description: The individual line items of the bill. At least one line is required; each line must be an AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail or ItemBasedExpenseLineDetail line.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Identifier of the line within the transaction. Required when updating an existing line in a sparse update.

attributes.name: LineNum
attributes.description: Position of the line in the collection of transaction lines.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: Free-form text description of the line item.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: The amount of the line item. Required for each line. Max 15 digits in 10.5 format.

attributes.name: DetailType
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating the type of line and which detail object is populated.

attributes.name: AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail
attributes.description: Detail for an account-based expense line. Populated when DetailType is AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail.

attributes.name: AccountRef
attributes.description: Reference to the expense account (Income/Expense type) for this line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Account object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Account.

attributes.name: TaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the TaxCode for this line item.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced TaxCode object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced TaxCode.

attributes.name: BillableStatus
attributes.description: Billable status of the expense line.

attributes.name: CustomerRef
attributes.description: Reference to the customer/job associated with this expense line (for billable expenses).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Customer object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Customer.

attributes.name: ClassRef
attributes.description: Reference to the Class associated with this expense line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Class object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Class.

attributes.name: MarkupInfo
attributes.description: Markup information for billable expense, including percent and markup account.

attributes.name: PercentBased
attributes.description: Whether the markup is percent based.

attributes.name: Value
attributes.description: Markup amount expressed as a percent of the line amount.

attributes.name: MarkUpIncomeAccountRef
attributes.description: Reference to the income account used to track markup income.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Account object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Account.

attributes.name: TaxAmount
attributes.description: Sales tax paid as part of the expense (non-US locales).

attributes.name: TaxInclusiveAmt
attributes.description: The total amount of the line including tax (non-US locales).

attributes.name: ItemBasedExpenseLineDetail
attributes.description: Detail for an item-based expense line. Populated when DetailType is ItemBasedExpenseLineDetail.

attributes.name: ItemRef
attributes.description: Reference to the Item for this line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Item object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Item.

attributes.name: Qty
attributes.description: Number of items for the line.

attributes.name: UnitPrice
attributes.description: Unit price of the item referenced by ItemRef.

attributes.name: PriceLevelRef
attributes.description: Reference to the PriceLevel for the item (read/write currently restricted by QBO).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced PriceLevel object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced PriceLevel.

attributes.name: TaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the TaxCode for this line item.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced TaxCode object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced TaxCode.

attributes.name: BillableStatus
attributes.description: Billable status of the item line.

attributes.name: CustomerRef
attributes.description: Reference to the customer/job associated with this item line (for billable items).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Customer object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Customer.

attributes.name: ClassRef
attributes.description: Reference to the Class associated with this item line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Class object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Class.

attributes.name: MarkupInfo
attributes.description: Markup information for billable item, including percent and markup account.

attributes.name: PercentBased
attributes.description: Whether the markup is percent based.

attributes.name: Value
attributes.description: Markup amount expressed as a percent of the line amount.

attributes.name: MarkUpIncomeAccountRef
attributes.description: Reference to the income account used to track markup income.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Account object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Account.

attributes.name: TaxInclusiveAmt
attributes.description: The total amount of the line including tax (non-US locales).

attributes.name: LinkedTxn
attributes.description: Transactions linked to this line (e.g., purchase orders linked at the line level).

attributes.name: TxnId
attributes.description: The Id of the linked transaction.

attributes.name: TxnType
attributes.description: The type of the linked transaction (e.g., PurchaseOrder).

attributes.name: TxnLineId
attributes.description: The line Id of the linked transaction.

fields.name: TxnDate
fields.description: The date entered by the user when this bill occurred. Defaults to the current date if not supplied.

fields.name: DueDate
fields.description: Date when the payment of the bill is due. If not provided, the due date is computed from the bill date and the vendor or sales-term settings.

fields.name: DocNumber
fields.description: Reference number for the transaction (e.g., the vendor's bill/invoice number). Max 21 characters.

fields.name: PrivateNote
fields.description: User-entered, private memo for internal use; not visible to the vendor. Max 4000 characters.

fields.name: APAccountRef
fields.description: Reference to the Accounts Payable account to which the bill is credited. If not specified, the default AP account is used.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Account object (must be an Accounts Payable account).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Account.

fields.name: SalesTermRef
fields.description: Reference to the sales/payment terms associated with the bill, used to compute the due date.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Term object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Term.

fields.name: CurrencyRef
fields.description: Reference to the currency in which all amounts on this bill are expressed. Applicable only when multicurrency is enabled.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full name of the currency.

fields.name: ExchangeRate
fields.description: The number of home-currency units it takes to equal one unit of the transaction currency. Applicable only when multicurrency is enabled.

fields.name: GlobalTaxCalculation
fields.description: Indicates how tax is applied to line items. Applicable only to non-US companies that support GST.

fields.name: TxnTaxDetail
fields.description: Tax details, including total tax and the breakdown of tax lines, applied to the transaction.

attributes.name: TxnTaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the transaction-level tax code applied to the bill.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced TaxCode object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced TaxCode.

attributes.name: TotalTax
attributes.description: Total tax calculated for the transaction, excluding any tax lines manually inserted into the transaction line list.

attributes.name: TaxLine
attributes.description: List of tax lines describing the taxes applied to the transaction.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: The tax amount for this tax line.

attributes.name: DetailType
attributes.description: Discriminator for the tax line; always 'TaxLineDetail'.

attributes.name: TaxLineDetail
attributes.description: Detail of the tax line.

attributes.name: TaxRateRef
attributes.description: Reference to the TaxRate applied.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced TaxRate object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced TaxRate.

attributes.name: PercentBased
attributes.description: Whether the tax rate is percent based.

attributes.name: TaxPercent
attributes.description: The tax rate percentage applied.

attributes.name: NetAmountTaxable
attributes.description: The net taxable amount on which tax is computed.

fields.name: DepartmentRef
fields.description: Reference to the department (location) tracking the bill, when location/department tracking is enabled.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Department object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Department.

fields.name: RecurDataRef
fields.description: Reference to the recurring transaction template (RecurringTransaction) from which this bill was generated.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced RecurringTransaction object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced recurring template.

fields.name: LinkedTxn
fields.description: Transactions linked to this bill at the transaction level (e.g., bill payments, purchase orders, reimbursable charges applied).

attributes.name: TxnId
attributes.description: The Id of the linked transaction.

attributes.name: TxnType
attributes.description: The type of the linked transaction (e.g., PurchaseOrder, BillPaymentCheck, ReimburseCharge).

attributes.name: TxnLineId
attributes.description: The line Id of the linked transaction.

fields.name: TotalAmt
fields.description: Indicates the total amount of the bill. This is the sum of all line amounts plus tax; computed and maintained by QuickBooks.

fields.name: Balance
fields.description: The unpaid amount remaining on the bill. Calculated and maintained by QuickBooks.

fields.name: HomeBalance
fields.description: Convenience field for the unpaid balance expressed in the home currency. Applicable only when multicurrency is enabled. Calculated by QuickBooks.

fields.name: IncludeInAnnualTPAR
fields.description: Indicates whether the bill is included in the Taxable Payments Annual Report (TPAR). Applicable only to Australia (AU) locales.

fields.name: TransactionLocationType
fields.description: The account location, used by France locales to determine domestic vs. cross-border transactions.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive metadata about the object, maintained by QuickBooks.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was created in the QuickBooks company file.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last updated in the QuickBooks company file.

fields.name: domain
fields.description: The domain the object belongs to; always 'QBO' for this API.

fields.name: sparse
fields.description: Indicates whether the object response is a sparse representation (only specified fields populated).
